context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about life on a budget
purpose: Teach: まじめ/貧乏/ときどき/ついつい/おまけ/パンツ/ふえ/やってくる

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近さ、お客さんがふえてきたんだけど、なんか貧乏な学生ばっかりでチップ全然ないんだよね。
lines.en: Lately customers have been increasing, but they're all broke students and there are no tips at all.
lines.style: Casual griping tone with a slight laugh, friendly cafe-worker venting to a friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる〜。私もまじめに節約してるつもりなのに、ついついコンビニで甘いもの買っちゃうの。
lines.en: I get it. I'm trying to be serious about saving, but I keep buying sweets at the convenience store.
lines.style: Soft, dreamy voice mixed with playful guilt, drawing out vowels in a relaxed way.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あ〜それな。ときどき自分にご褒美ってやつ、結局それで月末ピンチになるんだよね。
lines.en: Oh, totally. You tell yourself it's an occasional reward, and then you're broke by the end of the month.
lines.style: Sympathetic chuckle, leaning in conspiratorially like sharing a relatable secret.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: しかもこの前、新しいパンツ買おうとしたら、おまけで靴下くれるセールがあってさ、つい余計に買っちゃった。
lines.en: And the other day, when I went to buy new underwear, they had a sale with bonus socks, so I ended up buying extra.
lines.style: Embarrassed giggle, voice rising at the punchline like confessing a small indulgence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、それ完全に店の作戦じゃん。おまけって書いてあるだけで財布のひも緩むよね。
lines.en: Mei, that's totally the store's strategy. The word 'bonus' alone loosens your wallet's grip.
lines.style: Teasing tone with mock-accusation, warm and amused like calling out a friend's habit.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うっ、図星。給料日がやってくるまでの一週間、もやしばっかり食べてる気がする。
lines.en: Ugh, bullseye. The week before payday arrives, I feel like I'm eating nothing but bean sprouts.
lines.style: Mock despair, slumping voice with a dramatic sigh, romantic-style melodrama applied to poverty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとこのご時世、まじめに働いてもお金ふえないし、こっちもなかなかつらいよ。
lines.en: Honestly in this economy, even working seriously doesn't grow your money, so it's pretty rough on our side too.
lines.style: Resigned but warm, almost philosophical, like an older sister sharing hard-won wisdom.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: だよね〜。でもこうやってアオイちゃんと喋れるだけで、ちょっと幸せになれるからいいや。
lines.en: Right? But just being able to chat with you like this makes me a little happier, so that's enough.
lines.style: Sincere and gentle, voice softening with affection, ending on a smiling, content note.
